body:
Implements T-P04 (S5) from .adlc/specs/enhancement-resolution-plan.md.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Replace computed dynamic import in plugins/adlc-cursor/hooks/adlc-pretool.mjs and adlc-audit.mjs with static literal-specifier loaders (keeping importModule injectable as a test seam) so esbuild statically inlines @adlc/build-gate and @adlc/flail-detector.
2. Extend scripts/build-cursor-mcp.mjs to verify version lockstep across all 4 @adlc dependencies in plugins/adlc-cursor/package.json (@adlc/core, @adlc/tickets, @adlc/build-gate, @adlc/flail-detector) and bundle all 8 Cursor hook scripts into self-contained ESM .bundle.mjs files.
3. Register builder-verified hook bundles in scripts/test/ticket-store-boundary.test.mjs (both isDirectWriterBypass and isPointerParseBypass) and GENERATED_VERSION_FILES in scripts/mutation-gate.mjs.
4. Update both plugins/adlc-cursor/hooks/hooks.json and plugins/adlc-cursor/hooks.json in lockstep to invoke the .bundle.mjs entrypoints and set failClosed: true on preToolUse, updating scripts/cursor-install-smoke.mjs and scripts/test/cursor-install-smoke.test.mjs.
5. Verify an isolated /tmp copy of plugins/adlc-cursor with zero ancestor node_modules denies a frozen rail write and handles ADLC_BUILD_GATE_ENFORCEMENT=1 without ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
title: Wave 1B Part 3 (T-P04): Bundle all 8 adlc-cursor hooks with esbuild and enable failClosed: true on preToolUse
